scientific_integrity: The proof is self-contained apart from standard Jordan and Gaussian-binomial facts; computational checks supplement rather than establish the infinite theorem. Independent verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic two and split square-zero local algebras; fixed finite field in the asymptotic. Full unpublished prior literature is not exhaustively knowable.
title: Characteristic-two nilpotency jump and orbit law for Rota–Baxter operators on square-zero local algebras
